scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @assistflow/shared && npm run build --workspace @assistflow/server && npm run build --workspace assistflow-widget && npm run build --workspace assistflow-workstation && npm run build --workspace assistflow-demo
scripts.predev:all: npm run build --workspace @assistflow/shared && npm run build --workspace assistflow-widget
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n shared,server,widget,workstation,demo -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run dev --workspace @assistflow/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @assistflow/server" "npm run dev --workspace assistflow-widget" "npm run dev --workspace assistflow-workstation" "npm run dev --workspace assistflow-demo"
